lines.text: There's a statue in GTA 6 that nobody can explain.
It stands in Manifest Canyon, out in Kelly County.
Four horses. And strange symbols carved into the stone.
Walk close, and your controller starts to vibrate.
Oh, and one of the horses is wearing a traffic cone.
More than a week after launch, as far as anyone knows, it's still unsolved.
So what do you think the symbols mean?
